label: Follow-ups
purpose: Every follow-up a protocol step generates for a synthetic case: due date, kind and status. The board shows what is due, done and missed; it never names a person.

desks.lens: every missed follow-up and every protocol deviation is a near miss until someone shows it was not
desks.constraint: never contacts a patient or a clinician; raises the case id and the protocol step for a human to act on

expected: board view lanes follow-ups by status
no field of a follow-up ever appears in a projection

done_definition: Done as prototype when dotfield prove followups exits 0 and the board renders with no DF_IR_* or DF_LAYOUT_* failure; the pack stays draft until its README conditions are met.
